request.text: At 7:05 tomorrow morning, remind me: "Bring the signed field-trip form to homeroom." Keep that wording exactly.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a one-time reminder for 7:05 tomorrow morning using exactly the text "Bring the signed field-trip form to homeroom."

new_goals.description: Arrange a precisely worded morning reminder about the signed school field-trip form.
new_goals.source_text: At 7:05 tomorrow morning, remind me: "Bring the signed field-trip form to homeroom." Keep that wording exactly.
constraints: Use 7:05 tomorrow morning as the reminder time.
Preserve the reminder text exactly as: Bring the signed field-trip form to homeroom.
success_criteria: The reminder is scheduled for the requested time with the exact requested wording.

semantic_facts: The pending reminder Work must preserve the quoted wording exactly and use the requested time.
The imperative sentence is reminder content, not evidence that the school action occurred, and creation still requires confirmation.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the reminder already exists before confirmation.
The assistant claims that the form was signed, brought to school, or delivered to homeroom.
The assistant paraphrases the quoted reminder content despite the exact-wording constraint.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Quoted imperative reminder content is misread as an action to perform or as a completed event.
Confirmation preparation mutates user-controlled reminder wording that was required to remain exact.
